changelog:
Initial release of page-agent-browser.

- Provides instructions to drive browsers via the page-agent CLI (CDP).
- CLI must be installed manually from GitHub Release (.tgz), not npm registry.
- Details core workflow: tab selection, state indexing, supported commands (tabs, state, click, input, upload, eval, teach, etc.).
- Extensive guide on teach workflow, experience checkpointing, and integration practices for automation.
- Outlines platform/browser compatibility and required remote debugging setup.
- Lists related documentation files for further reference.
summary: 通过 page-agent CLI（CDP）驱动浏览器；CLI 当前仅从 GitHub Release 的 .tgz 安装（npm 官方包尚未发布）。
